items.question: Do you provide both local and imported marble?
items.answer: Yes — The Royal Stone stocks a full range of local Pakistani stone alongside imported marble and granite, all available to view at our Mandi Bahauddin showroom.

items.question: Do you handle installation, or just supply materials?
items.answer: We manage the complete process end-to-end: consultation, material selection, professional installation and final inspection, all with our own trained team.

items.question: Which areas do you serve?
items.answer: We currently serve customers across Punjab, with our showroom and workshop based in Phalia, Mandi Bahauddin.

items.question: How long does a typical flooring or kitchen top project take?
items.answer: Timelines vary with scope, but most residential flooring or kitchen top projects are completed within one to three weeks after material selection.

items.question: Can I visit the showroom before deciding?
items.answer: Absolutely — we welcome walk-ins at our Sargodha Road showroom, and our team is happy to walk you through samples in person.

items.question: How do I get a quotation?
items.answer: Reach out via WhatsApp, phone, or the contact form below with your project details, and we'll arrange a site visit and itemised quote.
